title: Demo: Acme Code Generator (GUI, WASM-verified grading)
summary: Identical task surface to demo/hello (GUI flow, same input/software/reference/output layout). Sole difference: evaluate() delegates the decision core to the EvoRule WASM grading engine — same list[float] score, plus a BLAKE3-audited receipt (facts_hash / audit_chain_head) that anyone can independently recompute in a browser or with a zero-dependency CLI.
